market_pulse.narrative: Multiple jurisdictions across Africa and Asia are tightening gambling regulations – Rwanda issued new licenses, Kenya proposes penalties for delayed payouts, Mozambique introduces SMS advertising rules, and Alberta opens its iGaming market while Thailand cracks down on illegal operations.

market_pulse.theme: Prediction markets and sports betting innovation
market_pulse.narrative: Prediction markets are becoming a focal point for both regulators and operators, with tribal gaming groups lobbying in Washington, DraftKings targets being revised by Morgan Stanley, and major operators like Crypto.com reshuffling leadership around prediction‑market products.

Industry leaders are emphasizing board governance, B2B marketing transformation, and professional development, highlighted by SBC’s board‑focused event, a report on evolving B2B media buying, and CPD‑accredited learning at major summits.

Operators are rapidly expanding into new markets and refreshing product lines – Play971 adds IGT and Endorphina games, Greentube launches in Alberta, BetMGM revamps its Borgata offering, and several operators gear up for the Alberta iGaming launch.

market_pulse.theme: World Cup 2026 betting surge and related partnerships
market_pulse.narrative: Multiple operators and data providers are leveraging the 2026 FIFA World Cup to drive record betting volumes, forge data partnerships, and launch sponsorships, while also facing scrutiny over match‑fixing integrity claims.
